d: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele has announced land operations in the Caribbean Nation of Haiti. El Salvador has deployed 2,000 elite troops to Haiti after 4 Salvadoran air force technicians were taken hostage by Haitian Gangs. Nayib Bukele has pledged to crack down on the gangs in Haiti until they return the 4 captives. The 4 Salvadorans were kidnapped near Croix-des-Bouquets, near Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince, while they were returning to their airbase.
